newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended a little firmer against the dollar in quiet trade and steady against the central bank's currency basket, dealers said.
The forint finished at 188.14/19 to the dollar, compared to 188.25/30 at opening.
Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria said the market followed dollar/mark crosses.
(The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.)
